mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cards (account_id, name, card_type, balance, created_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{name}, #{cardType}, 0, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, name, card_type, balance, created_at FROM cards WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, account_id, name, card_type, balance, created_at FROM cards WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards c WHERE c.account_id = #{accountId} AND (c.balance != 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM expenses e WHERE e.card_id = c.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM card_charges cc WHERE cc.card_id = c.id))
